_comment: Copy to accounts.json (gitignored) and fill in. Use password_env to pull secrets from the environment instead of storing them here. Five strategies are implemented: smoke_atm_roundtrip (P1 smoke test), reddit_sentiment_qqq (#22), trump_whisperer_qqq (#29), momentum_qqq, and looking_glass_straddle; the dip/rip/cheap-ATM ones are still P3. looking_glass_straddle (alias 'Cheshire' below) is a provisional-research direction-neutral 0DTE QQQ opening straddle -- buy num_straddles ATM calls+puts at entry_time_et, sell core_sell_count of each leg the first time the position's live value reaches C0*(1+core_profit_threshold_pct), and let the N-k runner ride uncapped to terminal_exit_time_et (or liquidate everything there on a no-touch day); no re-entry once a day's sequence has traded. See crassus/strategies/looking_glass_straddle.py's module docstring for why entry/exit are unavoidably two legs across separate runner cycles (Decision only ever places one symbol per cycle) and for why the params below are one representative point in the strategy brief's own validation sweep, not a tuned result. The runner validates strategy_id at startup and refuses to start rather than crashing mid-run on an unregistered one. The split below is deliberate -- running every account on one strategy only measures variance -- and the three reddit_sentiment_qqq accounts run conservative / default / aggressive thresholds so the Automated tab's per-strategy rollup compares something real. Neither sentiment strategy needs credentials: reddit_sentiment_qqq scrapes Reddit's public new.json (with a headless-browser fallback for Reddit's JS challenge, optionally set REDDIT_USER_AGENT as a courtesy identifier); trump_whisperer_qqq (alias 'TrumpWhisperer' below) polls the public trumpstruth.org/feed RSS mirror of Trump's Truth Social posts, optionally set TRUMP_FEED_USER_AGENT the same way. Both return no_trade -- rather than crashing, or in TrumpWhisperer's case rather than closing a held position -- below min_sample_size or if ingestion fails. momentum_qqq (alias 'Newton' below) needs no credentials or external feed either -- its signal is the trailing return of the same underlying_price every other strategy already reads off the durable snapshot, accumulated into a rolling window in-process; it stands down the same way while that window is still warming up or has a gap in it (see crassus/momentum.py). momentum_qqq also accepts two optional params, both off/no-op by default so no existing account's behavior changes unless explicitly set: 'vwap_confirmation_required' (bool) vetoes an otherwise-supported direction unless the underlying is on the agreeing side of its own session VWAP, and 'rvol_floor' (float) vetoes it unless relative volume clears that multiple -- both read from the collector-computed underlying_market block (see crassus/vwap_rvol.py and docs/plans/2026-07-vwap-rvol.md). Neither is set on any account below; RVOL in particular reports 'insufficient_history' until the collector's self-bootstrapping baseline has accumulated enough trading days, during which a held position is retained rather than closed, same as a stale snapshot. Every account is also end-of-day flattened (see crassus/flatten.py): this is mandatory, not a params opt-in -- a position that never gets a reversing signal from its own strategy still gets force-closed inside the last DEFAULT_FLATTEN_MINUTES_BEFORE_CLOSE (15) minutes before the 4pm close, rather than riding untouched into next session's settlement sweep. 'flatten_minutes_before_close' can widen or narrow that window per account if set explicitly, but no params value turns it off.
